title: Banque Delubac & Cie says intrusion led to customer data leak; fraud attempt failed
date_note: The bank's statement says the intrusion was detected on Friday 20 November.
geo_basis: Le Monde Informatique says the bank was founded in Le Cheylard, Ardeche; the bank's notice does not state its headquarters, so the pin is approximate
summary: Banque Delubac & Cie says it detected an intrusion into its systems on Friday 20 November, with a failed attempt at fraudulent financial operations. The bank says the intrusion led to a leak of data on part of its clientele and that the investigation continues to establish its extent. It suspended online banking and fund movements; fund movements were restored Monday morning. It informed the ACPR and CNIL and filed a complaint.
plain: French bank Delubac & Cie says someone broke into its systems on 20 November and tried to make fraudulent payments, which failed. Data on some customers leaked. It paused online banking and fund movements; fund movements are back.
exec: A French bank says an intrusion led to a leak of data on part of its customers and a failed fraud attempt; online banking and fund movements were suspended.

validation.note: Primary source: the bank's own press statement on delubac.com (23 November), read; Le Monde Informatique (23 November) reports the same statement and adds that it gives neither the type of data nor the number of customers.

review.note: stronger than the source: removed 'no customer or bank assets are affected', 'hackers' and 'transfers' (page says fund movements); added that extent is under investigation; geo basis softened (HQ not stated)
